en.text:
Increases Grenade Impact damage:
• 12.12% increase on <special/>Special Grenade Launchers 
• 12.5% increase on <heavy/>Power Grenade Launchers

Due to the ratio of Detonation and Impact damage being tied to the Blast Radius stat on Grenade Launchers, a lower stat will provide a slightly higher overall damage increase.

/*Total Damage Increases:
• Lightweight <special/>Special GLs at 95-100 BR: 10.8-10.1%
• Double Fire <special/>Special GLs at 55-85 BR: 17.9-13.2%
• Adaptive <heavy/>Heavy GLs at 45-100 BR: 11.2-6.3%
• Rapid-Fire <heavy/>Heavy GLs at 15-100 BR: 13.9%-6.3%

Note that these values won't necessarily be accurate if other damage perks that only affect Impact or Explosive Damage (like Explosive Light) are active.*/
